Crisp parmesan and pea risotto balls.How to make it30g butter1 brown onion, finely diced250g arborio rice800ml hot vegetable stock60g parmesan, finely grated1/2 cup frozen peas100g mozzarella, cut in small cubes2 eggs, beaten100g panko breadcrumbs1 L vegetable oil, for fryingSoften the onion in the butter, stir in the rice, then add the stock a ladle at a time until creamy and tender.Stir in the parmesan and peas, spread on a tray and chill until firm.Roll into 12 balls around a cube of mozzarella, dip in egg and roll in panko.Fry at 180°C until golden and hot in the middle.Astrophage black bean dipAstrophage toots to scoot. Smoky black beans with lime and corn chips.How to make it2 x 400g tins of black beans, drained1 garlic clove1 tsp smoked paprika1 tsp ground cumin2 limes3 tbsp olive oil60g feta, crumbled230g bag plain corn chipsWarm the spices in the oil for a minute.Blend the beans, garlic, spiced oil and lime juice with a splash of water until smooth.Spread in a bowl, scatter with feta and serve with corn chips.Squeeze-pouch apple pureeMeals for one, 11.9 light years out.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.Hot messTime go fishing salt-baked snapperRocky's fishing plan for Adrian. Whole snapper baked in a salt crust, lemon butter.How to make it1.2kg whole snapper, cleaned and scaled1.5kg coarse cooking salt3 egg whites2 lemons4 thyme sprigs80g butter1kg baby potatoesMix the salt with the egg whites until it feels like wet sand.Stuff the fish with lemon slices and thyme, lay it on a bed of salt and pack the rest over it.Bake at 200°C, with the potatoes boiling alongside.Melt the butter with lemon juice, crack the crust at the table and serve with the potatoes.Amaze amaze amaze five-spice pork bellyRocky, five-legged engineer from Erid. Crackling pork belly, five-spice and greens.How to make it1.2kg pork belly, skin scored2 tsp Chinese five-spice2 tbsp soy sauce1 tbsp honey1 tbsp sea salt flakes2 bunches of bok choy, halved1 tbsp sesame oil300g jasmine riceRub the flesh side of the pork with the five-spice, soy and honey, keeping the skin dry, then rub salt into the skin.Roast at 160°C, then turn up to 240°C until the skin crackles.Cook the rice and steam the bok choy, then dress it with sesame oil.Rest the pork, chop into thick pieces and serve with the rice and greens.Sweet issueSmall-to-medium whoop pavlovaGrace calls a dimming Sun a small whoop. Crisp meringue, cream and passionfruit.How to make it4 egg whites220g caster sugar2 tsp cornflour1 tsp white vinegar300ml thickened cream4 passionfruits250g strawberries, halvedWhisk the egg whites to soft peaks, then add the sugar a spoon at a time until thick and glossy.Fold in the cornflour and vinegar and spread into a 20cm round on a lined tray.Bake at 120°C, then turn off the oven and leave it inside to cool.Whip the cream, pile it on and top with strawberries and passionfruit.CanteenPetrova line infrared spritzA line of infrared between Sun and Venus. Aperol, prosecco and soda with blood orange.How to make it240ml Aperol500ml prosecco250ml soda water1 blood orange, sliced2 cups ice cubesFill 4 wine glasses with ice and add 60ml Aperol to each.Top with prosecco and a splash of soda and tuck in a slice of blood orange.Recycled ship's waterFiltered.
